# Support matrix

<!-- Generated by `hopshift matrix render` from support.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Which source platforms hopshift can migrate to which targets, and how far each pair has
been proven. The pairs are declared in `support.yaml`; every name is checked against the
source and target registries, so a row can only exist for something that is actually
registered. How a pair moves up a tier is described in [plugins.md](plugins.md).

## Legend

| Tier | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ![tested](https://img.shields.io/badge/tested-2ea44f) | exercised against real infrastructure (a lab or a cloud account) in addition to the CI validation |
| ![validated](https://img.shields.io/badge/validated-1f6feb) | rendered and validated by terraform validate, tflint and OPA in CI |
| ![experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/experimental-d4a72c) | renders, not yet validated end to end |

## Sources x targets

| Source \ Target | `aws` | `azure` | `gcp` | `openstack` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vmware` | ![validated](https://img.shields.io/badge/validated-1f6feb) | ![validated](https://img.shields.io/badge/validated-1f6feb) | ![validated](https://img.shields.io/badge/validated-1f6feb) | ![validated](https://img.shields.io/badge/validated-1f6feb) |

`-` means no declared support: the pair may render, but nothing vouches for it.

## Pairs

| Source | Target | Tier | Evidence | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vmware` | `aws` | validated | tests/integration/test_terraform_validate.py and tests/integration/test_conformance_terraform.py (terraform validate, tflint, OPA with zero enforce violations) on every CI run; tests/targets/test_conformance.py. | Images (AMIs) come from AWS VM Import/Export and are passed through var.image_overrides; not yet exercised against an AWS account from CI. |
| `vmware` | `azure` | validated | tests/integration/test_terraform_validate.py and tests/integration/test_conformance_terraform.py (terraform validate, tflint, OPA with zero enforce violations) on every CI run; tests/targets/test_conformance.py. | Linux VMs only (azurerm_linux_virtual_machine); encryption at host stays advisory because it needs a subscription feature. |
| `vmware` | `gcp` | validated | tests/integration/test_terraform_validate.py and tests/integration/test_conformance_terraform.py (terraform validate, tflint, OPA with zero enforce violations) on every CI run; tests/targets/test_conformance.py. | Imported images must carry the UEFI_COMPATIBLE guest OS feature for Shielded VM. |
| `vmware` | `openstack` | validated | tests/integration/test_terraform_validate.py and tests/integration/test_conformance_terraform.py (terraform validate and OPA with zero enforce violations) on every CI run; tests/targets/test_conformance.py. | tflint has no ruleset for the OpenStack provider, so only terraform validate and OPA gate the output. |

## Keeping this page current

Edit `support.yaml`, then run `hopshift matrix render`. CI runs `hopshift matrix check` and fails
when this file does not match the YAML.
